name: Black Bear
printing: ©2016 original organized-play module , as labeled in the cover imprint.
sourceAccess: The local publisher supplies the printed mechanics. The official adventure index corroborates the title and code.
errataEvidence: The official organized-play FAQ changes the adventure’s minimum and maximum character XP to 450 and 600. It gives no adjustment to this creature’s statistics or individual award.
habitatEvidence: Search habitats derive from the cited encounters in the adventure.
appearanceEvidence: The printed encounter on p. 16 describes an emaciated black bear. The portrait depicts that individual.
mechanicsNotes: P. 23 shows 100 XP in the creature block. P. 20 lists 200 XP per foe in the combat rewards. The overlay XP is the creature block value.
